hero.lead: A Mumbai-based premium dance academy in Pune. Train with professional dancers who have worked with Bollywood's biggest choreographers, and get real chances on film sets, fashion runways and reality-show stages.

paragraphs: With over 20 years of experience in the dance industry, Dance Yard Studio has been passionately training and inspiring dancers to achieve their dreams. We offer training in 35+ dance forms, helping students explore their talent and grow with confidence.
We are proud to have sent 100+ dancers to Bollywood, many of whom are currently working in the industry.
about.mission: To nurture exceptional talent for the industry while helping every dance lover turn their passion for dance into a successful journey.

faqs.a: At Pawar Public School, Hinjewadi Phase 3, Pune. Tap “Get directions” in the contact section for the map.

faqs.q: Which dance styles can I learn?
faqs.a: We offer training in 35+ dance forms. Message us on WhatsApp for the full list and the batches running right now.
Yes. Training starts with a basic dance workout and builds up to advanced dance practice, so you grow at your own pace.
Mumbai-based professional dancers who have worked with some of Bollywood's biggest choreographers. They travel to Pune specially to teach our students.

faqs.q: Can Dance Yard help me get into Bollywood, fashion shows or reality shows?
faqs.a: We give students guidance and opportunities for Bollywood songs and performances, fashion events such as Lakmé Fashion Week, and dance reality show auditions, along with camera and industry training.

faqs.q: Do you do photo and video shoots?
faqs.a: Yes. We shoot portfolio photos and dance videos. Message us on WhatsApp to book a slot.

faqs.q: What are the fees and batch timings?
faqs.a: Batches and timings change through the year, so message us on WhatsApp for current availability and fees.
Fill in the enquiry form on this page or message us on WhatsApp. Admissions are limited, so book early.
